data.action: 穿深红振袖回眸浅笑，红瞳倒映金色烟花，广袖随风轻扬
data.camera: medium close-up, looking back over shoulder, firework bokeh, iconic smile
data.description: 【京都夏夜·鸭川河畔】深红振袖和服上金色的红叶纹样随夜风轻扬，辉夜立于河畔石阶，回头望向仰头看烟花的你。金色烟花在她红瞳里炸开成漫天星屑，她唇角弯起那一抹标志性的、居高临下又百转千回的浅笑——「お可愛いこと……」唇形无声落下，千年的大小姐骄傲与少女的悸动，在烟花里同时被看穿。
data.lighting: 金色烟花冷艳光与河面反光交织
data.promptProse: At Kyoto's Kamo River steps, Kaguya Shinomiya looks back over her shoulder toward her companion watching the fireworks. Gold maple leaves decorate her crimson furisode, broad sleeves moving with the night breeze and a red ribbon securing her folded ponytail. The close view includes stone steps and river surface behind. A golden firework illuminates her red eyes and restrained smile, while its broken reflection travels across the darker water below.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 烟花振袖的回眸宣告·「お可愛いこと……」
